en: Colorized vintage street scene showing an old market street with low shops and houses with wooden balconies and tiled roofs. People in traditional early‑20th‑century Balkan or Ottoman‑style clothing stand near baskets of produce in the unpaved street. The buildings are close together and there is a mix of men in long coats and women with head coverings. A faint web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower part of the image.
